indexes.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX customers_pkey ON benchmark.customers USING btree (customer_id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX orders_pkey ON benchmark.orders USING btree (order_id)

protocol.uniform: Each customer has equal probability of receiving an order
protocol.controlled_columns: Identical order dates, statuses, amounts and insertion order in both datasets
protocol.selection: Fixed prior customer_id index; no re-optimization by distribution
protocol.phase_order: Baseline first in trials 1 and 3; indexed first in trial 2
protocol.measurement: Frequency-weighted mean of per-query execute + fetchall medians
protocol.summary: Median of per-trial metrics; gain is median paired percentage
protocol.statistics: ANALYZE after loading; autovacuum disabled on experiment tables only
limitations: Same query literals can return different row counts across distributions.
Existing workload emphasizes low customer IDs, which are hot in the skewed dataset.
Timing differences without diagnostic index use do not establish an index benefit.
Three trials on one machine do not establish statistical significance.

protocol.frequency_usage: aggregation weights; equal repeats per query
